name: hackathon demo judge
description: how a hackathon judge sees a project in a five minute demo: what works, what it is, and how hard it was.

criteria.name: it works live
criteria.description: the demo runs, or there is an honest recorded fallback
criteria.strong_answer: a live run or a recording of a real run

criteria.name: one clear idea
criteria.description: what the project is can be said in one sentence
criteria.strong_answer: a one-liner that fits the demo

criteria.name: technical depth
criteria.description: the hard part is identified and was actually solved
criteria.strong_answer: the mechanic, visible or explained with evidence

criteria.name: scope honesty
criteria.description: the team is honest about what is stubbed or mocked

criteria.name: relevance to the event
criteria.description: the project fits the hackathon's theme and rules
criteria.strong_answer: uses the event's platform or theme, within rules

red_flags: a slide deck instead of a demo
a project started before the event
objection_seeds: can you run it again live
what breaks if i poke it
trusted_evidence: repo evidence committed during the event
